presented, I believe the attached timeline would work for all the concepts with the special
caveat on the Millennial Party. If that concept is selected, I cannot emphasize enough the
need to start immediately. I realize that any program needs to be put out for bids and this
requires some time. However, it is our view that as individuals begin confirming plans for
this New Years Eve, it will only enhance their resolve to do something about their Year

about hotel rooms. We believe the sooner that hotel rooms can be secured, the better
chance we have of getting preferred locations.
